title: Piedmont Hot Airline
specs: Flights at sunrise or sunset for calmer, more stable weather
Pilot Ian Leonard is FAA commercial certified with over 23 years experience
Passengers must be healthy enough to participate and climb in and out of the basket
All passengers must sign a liability waiver; minors require parent or guardian signature
Total passenger weight cannot exceed 850 lbs per flight
Minimum 2 passengers and maximum 4 passengers per flight
Contact operator for groups larger than 4
gap: Exact location and address not stated
blurb: Guests fly in a hot air balloon for approximately one hour during the first two hours after sunrise or the last two hours before sunset. Flights depend on weather conditions including wind speed and no rain or thunderstorms. Passengers must be healthy enough to climb in and out of the basket and sign a liability waiver.
extraNote: Flights only when surface winds are less than 10 MPH and winds aloft less than 20 MPH · No flights in rain or thunderstorms · Flights scheduled at sunrise or sunset · Minimum 2 passengers and maximum 4 passengers per flight · Prices subject to change · March through December
